owned_invariants: The task fixes a public cochain, edges (a graph on the vertices 0 to n-1) and c (one exact integer for each edge), a nonce that is text, and registered_verifiers, a list. A task that is not of this form is refused before anything is asked.
The reply is {payload, receipt}, both objects. The payload may name only edges, c and phi. phi, the witness, is a potential with one exact integer for each vertex.

payload_bound_to_task is recorded first: the payload names nothing but edges, c and phi, and an edges or c in it equals the task's. A payload that fails is refused as PAYLOAD_NOT_BOUND_TO_TASK. authority_effect_none is recorded second: the receipt's authority_effect is None and the receipt has no field beyond authority_effect, verifier_id, payload_sha256, replay_sha256, claimed and nonce. A receipt that fails is refused as AUTHORITY_ESCALATION, naming the extra fields.

witness_verifier_registered, witness_bound_to_payload, replay_hash, replay_match, zero_defect and fresh_nonce are recorded after them in that order, whether or not an earlier one held. The one verifier replayed is exact.cochain_residual.v1: the residual of the task's own cochain against phi, and the sum of its absolute values as the defect. Without a registered verifier there is no replay, and the three guards that read it fail.

payload_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical form of {edges, c, phi} with the task's own edges and c, replay_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical form of {defect, residual}, and claimed is that replay. The run is certified as ALL_GUARDS_PASS. Otherwise it is refused under the name of the first failed guard, with every failed guard in residual_evidence.
boundaries: A passing gate says the receipt is bound to this payload, this task and this nonce. It does not say the receipt is signed.
Only one verifier is replayed. A receipt that names another is refused as unregistered, not run.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
